name: URY landscape kiosk checkout
describe: Checkout under the repeated kiosk header: "Order Summary" card with the lines, item count and total, a "Payment Method" card with full-width option buttons (Pay Online, Pay at Counter, Request Bill) and a full-width primary action.

The shared screen is not rescaled for the kiosk, so the cards span the whole 1920px width (mx-4). Which options appear depends on the capabilities. Fixed UI labels are author translations for RTL (the self-order app has no locale file) and NEED NATIVE REVIEW; RTL is a kit extension.
